C:P1.5.text: The Bay-Walton Sector Plan is a Long-Term Master Plan on 110,500 acres of the company’s land holdings located in Bay County and Walton County. The framework was finalized after extensive public participation at workshops, open houses, and public hearings -2015. The plan was approved by Bay County, Walton County, and the State of Florida pursuant to Section 163.3245, Florida Statues.

C:P1.6.text: An integral component of the Bay-Walton Sector Plan is the creation of a regionally significant water-shed level environmental framework that contains 53,229 acres or 48 percent of the master plan in a series of well-connected conservation and preservation areas, especially for the protection of West Bay.
